records.title: General Specifications for Electrical Works, Part I: Internal
records.remarks: Supersedes the 2013 edition. Source document supplied by KES on 30 July 2026 (331 pages, 20 chapters, Appendices A-L, Tables 1-11H) — verification_status can be set to SOURCE_VERIFIED. See part1_internal_chapter_index.json for chapter/appendix/table structure.

records.title: General Specifications for Electrical Works, Part II: External
records.remarks: Source document supplied by KES on 30 July 2026 (237 pages, 9 chapters covering cable work, trenchless cable work, overhead lines, aerial bunched cables, road/external lighting, poles and high masts, Appendices A-H). verification_status can be set to SOURCE_VERIFIED. See part2_external_chapter_index.json for chapter/appendix/table structure. Chapters 2-5 (cable work, trenchless, overhead line, ABC) and their Tables 1(A)-VI are directly relevant to EOS-04 (Short-Circuit) and EOS-06 (Cable Sizing).
